blurb: St-Cyrly Yours offers event planning and management services including weddings, corporate events, and private boat cruises on Okanagan Lake. They provide full-service wedding packages, corporate event planning, and private pontoon boat charters. Their pontoon boat accommodates up to 12 guests and includes amenities for comfort and entertainment.
extraNote: 50% deposit required at booking for pontoon boat charters; minimum 2 hours rental · Cancel pontoon boat charter at least 7 days in advance for refund; otherwise no refund · Pontoon boat charters reschedule for bad weather within 365 days or full refund · Various downtown Kelowna lakefront hotels/resorts, public launch next to Rose's Pub, or any public/private dock on Okanagan Lake.
